package.name: warehouse_scenario
package.description:
The Amazon-warehouse scenario, in the epistemic reading.
The floor plan follows the RoboticsAcademy multi-robot Amazon warehouse exercise: shelf blocks with aisles between them, a cross corridor at each end, and loading docks on the east wall. What it adds is what the robots do not know, and it adds it to the map rather than around it: a corridor nobody has looked into is unknown rather than free, and which aisle holds the pallet is a disagreement between two worlds one robot can tell apart and another cannot.
Four executables: make_maps writes the floor where map_server and rviz can read it, run_offline answers every case with no ROS in the way, scenario_driver puts the same cases to a running mu_path_planner node over topics, and render_scenario draws the answers.
